items.statement: Brief says 0.3195 is the highest score. The official board shows 0.3195 at rank #9 (DARD); rank #1 is xiaofanhu at 0.4133.
Brief lists a '0.3774 GEMSDOE high score'. No such row appears on the official board, and no GEMSDOE32 record contains 0.3774.

Brief attributes 0.2778 to GEMSDOE32 file h33-h33-2-b2. The GEMSDOE32 repository never records 0.2778, and its site says 'NO ORGANISER SCORE EXISTS'. The official board shows 0.2778 at rank #23 for participant extradr19, which cannot be linked to the file.
Brief describes the '1 m GeoDAWN lidar'. The USGS record describes GeoDAWN as magnetic and radiometric; the lidar is a separate USGS 3DEP product over a similar extent.

Brief cites 'AGU 2015 poster T31A-2838, tested in Surprise Valley' for slope-aware scarp templates. Session T31A lists no such identifier. The Sare & Hilley AGU poster is 70055, 'Mapping of normal fault scarps in airborne laser swath mapping data using wavelet analysis'.
Feature raster name differs by source: problem page 'training_features.tif'; reference notebook 'data/numeric_features.tif'. The verifier accepts both.
Label source differs: rules section 3.3 names only INGENIOUS; problem page names USGS Quaternary Fault and Fold plus INGENIOUS.
Owner registry shows labels.tif and existing_faults.tif with the same sha256 (7ba308cc...), i.e. one file under two names.

Owner repositories publicly mirror competition rasters (GEMSDOE32 registry, IR-32-DATA-01; GEMSDOE24 suspected). DrivenData's Terms of Use (S23) allow personal, non-commercial use only and prohibit redistributing site material except listed exceptions. A public copy of the competition data may therefore conflict with the terms. This project does not mirror or commit competition data; manual terms review is pending.
items.status: NEEDS MANUAL TERMS REVIEW (ToU read; rules data licence not checked)

items.statement: Footprint count disagreement: owner computes 5,165,852 finite cells; owner's own record says 5,167,373 (IR-32-DATA-02).
Rules A.5(1) require each submission to be an original work by the competitor. Submitting a TIF copied from another team's site would conflict with that warranty.
items.status: POLICY - enforced in this repo's guide

items.statement: Public leaderboard scores may differ from final private scores (rules 3.2). Comparisons here use the public board and say so.
The official metric page does not publish epsilon, the distance convention (pixel centres assumed), or NaN handling. Our implementation states these assumptions.
Owner site cites a 200-character limit for the submission note. The official form is behind the login and was not checked. Keep notes short.

Brief refers to files that did not exist in this repository at start: validate_submission.py, evaluate_holdout.py, submission_writer.py, a cached feature stack, and a cultural-feature mask. The repo contained only a one-line README. Markdown autolinks in the brief also corrupted these names. This repo now provides validate_submission, submission_writer and holdout; the feature stack and cultural mask are not present.

Competition data (features, labels, sample submission, DEM links) is behind a DrivenData login. The data tab redirects to the login page (S05, S24). Not accessible from this environment; only the user can complete this step.
Brief cites gdr.openei.org/submissions/1391 as a data source. It returns 'No submission found.' The GeoDAWN GDR entry found by search is /submissions/1591, so 1391 may be a typo. Not verified.
The lidar-scarp lane is already in the owner's registry as H33-C and H61-5 (and H60-5 for drainage). The brief asks for ideas 'we haven't tried', so this lane is not new.
Leaderboard snapshots drift quickly. The owner's 2026-10-04 snapshot had #1 at 0.3262; today's board has #1 at 0.4133. Any score must carry its read date.

Brief asks for 'a unique TIF submission' now. No validated file can be produced from this environment (no features, no labels, no official grid), so none is offered. Producing an unverified file would fail the gate and the format checks.
The leaderboard page rendered 50 rows followed by 'Loading...'. Rows beyond #50 were not observed.
Terms-of-use date: DrivenData ToU shows 'Last Modified: August 7, 2014' while the competition is from 2026. Whether a newer data licence applies is unverified.
